AI Notes.value: Utrecht-based independent graphic designer, artist, and typeface designer (b. 1988). Studied at AKV St. Joost (BA Graphic Design, 2010-2014). Visual Designer at Studio Dumbar, Rotterdam, 2014-2019, working on large-scale identity systems including Amsterdam Sinfonietta poster series and Dutch National Police. Independent since 2019 as graphic designer, visual artist, and art director. Represented by Moving Gallery (NL). TDC Ascenders award 2023. Practice spans identity systems, poster design, original typefaces (Rosdar, Sman, Nespor, Krisan and others), editorial/book design, and typographic art/murals. Senior-level independent; ~12 years experience, ~6 years solo. Autonomy 4: runs full projects independently, commissions across disciplines, gallery representation; not a creative director managing a team.
